case_title: LEMENOVA, IRINA VS FORD MOTOR COMPANY

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,500.00 FILED BY LEMENOVA, IRINA AS TO DEFENDANT FORD MOTOR COMPANY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-16-2006 AT 06:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION OCT-16-2006, CONTINUED BY COURT TO DEC-18-2006 AT 06:30 PM IN DEPT 506 MEDIATED SETTLEMENT. IF NO APPEARANCES, DISMISS WITH PREJUDICE.

SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION DEC-18-2006, CONTINUED BY COURT TO FEB-26-2007 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 506 MEDIATED SETTLEMENT PENDING. IF NO APPEARANCE DISMISS WITH PREJUDICE. IF SETTLEMENT NOT COMPLETED BY 2/26/07, ALL PARTIES SHALL APPEAR FOR TRIAL.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LEMENOVA, IRINA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FORD MOTOR COMPANY $7,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $85.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,585.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
